title: About Me
description: I’m Misbah Fathima, a third-year Computer Science Engineering student who enjoys building things for the web and solving problems through code. I’m passionate about software development, full-stack web technologies, and Data Structures & Algorithms. Through internships, projects, and hackathons, I’m gaining hands-on experience turning ideas into practical and user-friendly applications. Currently, I’m focused on strengthening my skills in Java, DSA, databases, and full-stack development while continuously exploring new technologies. Build. Learn. Improve. Repeat. 🚀
